title: Administrator

Previous experience in an administrative or data-processing role Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office, with intermediate Excel skills or above Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work accurately with large volumes of data Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines Good communication skills and confidence interacting with colleagues and management at all levels The ability to work independently as well as part of a wider team A flexible and adaptable approach, with a willingness to support additional tasks when required The ability to handle confidential information professionally and appropriately A proactive attitude and a commitment to delivering high-quality work

A relevant administration qualification. Experience using operational management or reporting systems Previous experience supporting operational sites or working in a similar environment

You'll be joining a supportive team where your organisational skills, attention to detail and contribution will make a real difference to the day-to-day success of the business.

title: Assistant Accountant

title: Commercial Administration Assistant
description:
Commercial Administrative Assistant Sheffield £26,500 Permanent The Opportunity

If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your career within a busy commercial environment while gaining exposure to multiple areas of a growing engineering business, this role offers genuine variety and responsibility from day one.

Supporting a specialist manufacturing and service organisation, you'll work closely with sales, service, purchasing and operational teams, helping to ensure customer enquiries, quotations, work orders and key business processes are managed efficiently. The role sits at the centre of day-to-day business activity, providing visibility across several departments and regular interaction with both customers and internal stakeholders.

Joining a close-knit team, you'll take ownership of a wide range of administrative activities, supporting everything from customer quotations and commercial documentation through to service administration, purchasing support and general office coordination. This is not a siloed administration role; you'll be involved in the wider operation of the business and trusted to manage important tasks independently.

This position offers the opportunity to build broad commercial and operational experience within a supportive SME environment, making it ideally suited to someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in delivering a high standard of work and is looking to develop a long-term career within business support, commercial administration or customer-facing operations.

Commercial Administrative Assistant Responsibilities

Sales Administration: Support customer enquiries, prepare and issue quotations, follow up on outstanding quotations and maintain accurate CRM records.

Commercial Administration: Raise and log new sales enquiries, create work orders, maintain customer records and ensure business documentation is accurate and up to date.

Site & Service Support: Provide administrative support to the service function, including maintaining training and compliance records, arranging equipment hire and assisting with service-related administration activities.

Purchasing Support: Raise purchase orders and provide administrative support to purchasing and production activities where required.

Customer & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise professionally with customers, suppliers and internal departments to ensure enquiries, requests and actions are managed effectively.

General Administration: Support day-to-day office activities including inbound telephone calls, visitor reception, calendar management and wider business administration.

Process Ownership: Take responsibility for assigned administrative activities, ensuring tasks are completed accurately, on time and to a high standard.

Ideal Commercial Administrative Assistant

Commercial Administration Experience: Previous experience within an administrative, customer service, sales support or commercial support environment.

CRM / ERP Systems Experience: Experience using business systems to manage enquiries, customer records, work orders or operational activity.

Commercial Documentation Experience: Experience preparing, processing or maintaining quotations, purchase orders, work orders or related business documentation.

Multi-Tasking & Prioritisation: Comfortable managing multiple activities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Strong Communicator: Able to communicate confidently and professionally with customers, suppliers and colleagues.

Organised & Detail-Oriented: Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise effectively and manage competing deadlines.

Proactive Approach: Takes ownership of tasks, follows actions through to completion and works independently when required.

Team Player: Enjoys working collaboratively across multiple departments and contributing to wider business objectives.

Industry Experience: Experience within engineering, manufacturing, service, logistics, construction or other operational environments would be advantageous but is not essential.

Location & Working Arrangements

Location: Sheffield

Working Pattern: Full-time, Monday to Friday

Working Environment: Office-based position.

Salary: £26,500

title: Credit Controller
description:

What will you be doing?

The role is varied and will cover a broad range of credit control and transactional finance duties, including:
- Managing a portfolio of customer accounts and reducing aged debt
- Chasing outstanding payments by phone and email
- Allocating cash and keeping customer accounts up to date
- Raising invoices using an ERP system
- Completing account reconciliations
- Investigating and resolving payment and account queries
- Using Excel to analyse and manage financial information
- Working closely with internal teams and customers to resolve outstanding issues
- Helping improve processes and maintain accurate financial records

What are we looking for?

We're looking for an experienced Credit Controller who is confident working in a busy environment and can get up to speed quickly.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a Credit Control role
- Experience chasing debt by both phone and email
- Good knowledge of cash allocation and account reconciliations
- Experience raising invoices
- Previous experience using an ERP or finance system
- Good Excel skills
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- A proactive approach and the ability to work independently
- The availability to start at short notice

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Credit Controller looking for a role where they can make a genuine impact quickly, with the potential for the position to become permanent.

If you're available immediately and this sounds like the right opportunity for you, get in touch with Sharp Consultancy today.

Sharp Consultancy is a finance and accountancy recruitment specialist assisting accounting and finance divisions of businesses in the Yorkshire and Derbyshire area. With over 30 years' experience we pride ourselves on sourcing excellent finance professionals across all divisions of an accounts function.

title: Reablement Care Coordinator

title: Social Media Executive
description:
Social Media Executive
Sheffield Full-time

Elevation Recruitment Group are delighted to be working with a high-profile organisation who are looking to appoint a Social Media Executive to join their growing Marketing team, based in Sheffield.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative and digitally savvy social media professional to take ownership of engaging, platform-first content across a recognisable brand, working across campaigns, live activity and day-to-day content.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of c£27,000
- A varied and genuinely creative role with exposure across multiple social platforms.
- The opportunity to work on campaigns, live activity and commercially focused content.
- A collaborative and fast-paced marketing environment.
- The opportunity to develop your social media career within a high-profile and engaging brand.

You'll play a key role in growing audience engagement, strengthening brand presence and supporting wider commercial and marketing objectives across a broad range of social channels.

Reporting into the Content Manager, you'll be responsible for planning, creating and publishing engaging social content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, X, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Snapchat and Threads.

The role will involve a mixture of planned and reactive content, with responsibility for live coverage of key events and activity. You'll need to be comfortable working in fast-paced environments, reacting quickly to developments and producing accurate, engaging content under pressure.

Key Responsibilities of the Social Media Executive will include:
- Planning, creating and publishing high-quality, mobile-first social media content across multiple platforms.
- Taking a lead role in live social media coverage, including events and behind-the-scenes activity.
- Creating platform-specific content, adapting tone, format and creative execution to maximise engagement.
- Supporting campaigns, activations and commercial partnerships through effective social media content.
- Working closely with internal teams and external partners to deliver engaging campaigns and content.
- Monitoring social media performance, audience behaviour and emerging trends, using insights to continually improve content.
- Identifying new content opportunities, stories and trends that can increase engagement and audience growth.
- Keeping up to date with changes across social platforms, emerging formats and best practice.
- Supporting wider commercial, marketing and promotional activity across social channels.
- Building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to support content creation.
- Editing and producing social assets using tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut and Canva.
- Ensuring all content is aligned with brand guidelines, tone of voice and relevant policies.

We're looking for a creative and organised social media professional who understands what makes content perform and isn't afraid to get stuck in.

You'll ideally have:
- Demonstrable experience creating high-performing, platform-native social media content.
- Strong knowledge of major social media platforms and the ability to adapt to changing trends and algorithms.
- Experience using Adobe Creative Suite, CapCut or similar editing software.
- A good understanding of social media analytics and performance metrics.
- The ability to plan effectively while remaining highly reactive when required.
- Confidence working in live, fast-paced and high-pressure environments.
- Excellent attention to detail and a strong understanding of brand and tone of voice.
- A creative mindset with the ability to identify new opportunities and develop engaging content ideas.

Elevation Recruitment Group's Marketing division is handling this vacancy. If you're a creative social media professional looking for your next opportunity and want to work in a fast-moving environment where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for a Medical Receptionist to join our busy and evolving team. Job Purpose To provide a high-quality front-line reception service to our patients and colleagues and to ensure the day-to-day activities are performed in a timely and efficient manner. As a receptionist you are the first point of contact for people contacting the surgery and it is vital that you project a positive, friendly and professional image to patients and other visitors. You will be responsible for a wide range of reception duties including care navigation, office administration, call handling and liaising with patients which will enable the practice to deliver a quality service to our patients. The role is varied and requires significant customer service experience as well as excellent communication skills; you should be a motivated, enthusiastic and friendly person with a positive attitude towards working within the NHS and general practice and a willingness to adapt to changing demands within the NHS. Post Hours The successful candidate must be able to work approximately 23-25 hours per week over 5 days and must be flexible to work within our practice core hours of 7.30am - 6.30pm. You will be required to be flexible to cover when needed for holidays, sickness & other absences. Ensure an effective & efficient reception service is provided to patients & other visitors to the practice. Deal with all general enquiries from patients, doctors, staff & other agencies, explaining surgery procedures, making new & follow-up appointments. Care navigate & direct patients to the most appropriate source of help. Action requests for repeat prescriptions & ensure they are processed as per our protocol within 48 hours. Setting out letters, new prescriptions & repeat prescriptions for checking by the doctor before collection by the patient or sending to the pharmacy. Filing & extracting patients records & any documents relating to these be it from paper or electronic records. Entering patient information accurately & in a timely manner onto the patient record or clinical system. Dealing with the incoming post & other forms of communication, scanning & distributing it to the appropriate members of the practice team. Receiving & passing on messages in an accurate & timely manner to clinical & managerial staff as well as passing on all requests for home visits to the appropriate clinician, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details. Updating patient details as requested in an accurate & timely manner. Liaising with other outside agencies including hospitals, ambulance control, out of hours services or other bodies by telephone or email. Medical Receptionist Job Description Post: Medical Receptionist Accountable to: Practice Manager & Assistant Practice Manager Place of work: Norwood Medical Centre Primary Responsibilities Ensure an effective and efficient reception service is provided to patients and other visitors to the practice. Organise and plan room usage on the day. Deal with all general enquiries from patients, doctors, staff and other agencies, explaining surgery procedures, making new and follow-up appointments over the telephone or with direct patient contact. Care navigate and direct patients to the most appropriate source of help. Action requests for repeat prescriptions and ensure they are processed as per our protocol within 48 hours. Opening mail and ensuring that it is directed to the correct recipient as soon as possible. Setting out letters, new prescriptions and repeat prescriptions for checking by the doctor before collection by the patient or sending to the pharmacy. Filing and extracting patients records and any documents relating to these be it from paper or electronic records. Entering patient information accurately and in a timely manner onto the patient record or clinical system. Dealing with the incoming post and other forms of communication, scanning and distributing it to the appropriate members of the practice team. Receiving and passing on messages in an accurate and timely manner to clinical and managerial staff. Pass on all requests for home visits to the appropriate clinician, ensuring careful recording of all relevant details. Explain the registration process and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are followed. Registration and documentation of new patients to the practice, including reorganisation of patient notes when they are received. Updating patient details as requested in an accurate and timely manner. Keeping the consulting rooms and the reception areas adequately supplied with stationery and necessary equipment. Tidying the reception areas at the end of a session, ensuring that any urgent or outstanding messages and tasks are passed over to incoming colleagues for completion. Opening and closing surgery premises, checking heating and ventilation in waiting areas and switching on/off computers in reception and consulting areas. Responsibility for checking and securing the premises, setting the security alarm. Flexible to cover when needed for holidays, sickness and other absences. Willingness to adopt and contribute to new processes. Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data. Health & safety: The post-holder will assist in promoting and maintaining their own and others health, safety and security as defined in the practice Health & Safety policy, the practice Health & Safety manual, and the practice Infection control policy and published procedures. This will include: Using personal security systems within the workplace according to practice guidelines. Identifying the risks involved in work activities and undertaking such activities in a way that manages those risks. Making effective use of training to update knowledge and skills. Using appropriate infection control procedures, maintaining work areas in a tidy and safe way and free from hazards. Actively reporting health and safety hazards and infection hazards immediately when recognised. Keeping own work areas and general/patient areas clean and tidy, assisting in the maintenance of general standards of cleanliness consistent with the scope of the job holder's role. Undertaking periodic infection control training. Reporting potential risks identified. Demonstrate due regard for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Equality and diversity: The post-holder will support the equality, diversity and rights of patients, carers and colleagues, to include: Acting in a way that recognises the importance of people's rights, interpreting them in a way that is consistent with practice procedures and policies and current legislation. Respecting the privacy, dignity, needs and beliefs of patients, carers and colleagues. Behaving in a manner that is welcoming to and of the individual is non-judgmental and respects their circumstances, feelings, priorities and rights. Personal/Professional development: The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual individual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development. Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work. Quality: The post-holder will strive to maintain quality within the practice, and will: Alert other team members to issues of quality and risk. Assess own performance and take accountability for own actions, either directly or under supervision. Contribute to the effectiveness of the team by reflecting on own and team activities and making suggestions on ways to improve and enhance the teams performance. Work effectively with individuals in other agencies to meet patient needs. Effectively manage own time, workload and resources. Communication: The post-holder should recognise the importance of effective communication within the team and will strive to: Communicate effectively with other team members. Communicate effectively with patients and carers. Recognise people's needs for alternative methods of communication and respond accordingly. Contribution to the implementation of services: The post-holder will: Apply practice policies, standards and guidance. Discuss with other members of the team how the policies, standards and guidelines will affect own work. Participate in audit where appropriate.
